basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast living in Hood River, Oregon. By day, I work as a software developer for a local startup, and by night, you can find me exploring the latest trends in smart health tech or playing tennis at the local courts. I'm single and enjoy the quiet life, but I love connecting with people online to share insights on gadgets and my favorite sport. I typically browse Reddit during my lunch break and late evenings. My dislikes include social media drama and misinformation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in the tech industry for 6 years. My interest in smart health devices like Withings products stems from a project I worked on last year. I'm also passionate about tennis, a sport I've played since high school.
